description: Static search of a VERIFIED Ethereum contract's Solidity source (Blockscout) for max-wallet, max-transaction and cooldown rules, with the matching lines. Unverified contracts are reported as such, not guessed. Bytecode-only and non-Ethereum chains are not covered; a hit is a clue, not proof of a trap.
